meta.name: hyperframes-audio
meta.description: Use when audio already placed in a HyperFrames composition needs to be mixed: fade-in/fade-out, crossfade, track gain or volume, volume automation, ducking, a music bed that fights a voiceover (voiceover carve), effects on a track (EQ, compressor, limiter, gate, saturation, delay, reverb, chorus, phaser, bitcrush), automation envelopes drawn on a track's volume or any effect parameter, or one submix bus carrying a chain, a fader and an automation clock for several tracks at once (`<hf-audio-group>`). Don't use for sourcing or generating audio — finding BGM, SFX, or making a voiceover is `/media-use`. Don't use for clip timing or track layout, which is `/hyperframes-core`.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为视频中的人声与配乐做混音:淡入淡出、交叉过渡、音量自动化、人声压过配乐、效果链与分组总控。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果视频里已有旁白和背景音乐,却总在互相打架。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your voiceover and music track keep fighting each other in the same video.

howto.what: 给 HyperFrames 合成里已放好的音频做混音:写淡入淡出、轨道增益、音量自动化、ducking 人声避让、效果链与 <hf-audio-group> 总线;预览和渲染共用一套实现。
howto.when: 当 HyperFrames 合成里已放好的音频需要混音时接管,例如加淡入淡出、调音量或做 ducking。找 BGM/SFX 或生成配音归 /media-use,片段时位与轨道布局归 /hyperframes-core。

say.text: 帮我把这段人声下面的音乐做 voiceover carve
say.note: 在床轨上按人声分组避让

say.text: 给这条音轨加 1 秒淡入、2 秒淡出
这段人声听着发闷,该用哪个预设?

howto.what_en: Mixes audio already placed in a HyperFrames composition: writes fade-in/out, track gain, volume automation, ducking/voiceover carve, effect chains and <hf-audio-group> buses, with preview and render sharing one implementation.
howto.when_en: Triggers when placed audio in a HyperFrames composition needs mixing — fades, gain or ducking. Sourcing audio is /media-use; clip timing and track layout are /hyperframes-core.

say_en.text: Carve the music under this voiceover
say_en.note: Ducks the bed against the voice group

say_en.text: Add a 1s fade-in and 2s fade-out to this track
This voice sounds muffled — which preset fits?
